The Chinese characters for Quinn

As a transliteration, Quinn is usually written 奎因 (Kuí yīn). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

With Irish origins, Quinn is usually read as “descendant of Conn”.
